2317-2438-4826-7084.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Repeat.

413-678-4022.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn
413-678-4022.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying its mana cost.
When Hidden Herbalists enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, untapping Blasting Station and adding {G}{G}.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Hidden Herbalists.
When Hidden Herbalists dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Hidden Herbalists from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

1742-1978-3088-3363.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
1742-1978-3088-3363.description:
Animate The One Ring using Xenic Poltergeist.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

944-2701-7182-7252.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}
Cast Grave Sifter for its evoke cost by paying {2} due to Planar Gate
When Grave Sifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Grave Sifter.
When Grave Sifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Grave Sifter with haste.
When the Grave Sifter token enters, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-2841-2907-8102.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Windswept Heath.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-2907-8102.description:
Fetch a land using Windswept Heath.
When the fetched land enters, Scute Swarm and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Scute Swarm trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Scute Swarm triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

2486-4247--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it and at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Remove a -1/-1 counter and a +1/+1 counter from that creature as a state-based action.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat

3899-4871-5220-5651.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3899-4871-5220-5651.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

1379-4186-6830-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-4186-6830-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-1872-6972.description:
Activate Composite Golem by sacrificing it.
When Composite Golem dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Repeat.

uses.n: Aang, Swift Savior // Aang and La, Ocean's Fury

2726-2906-7043.notablePrerequisites: Your opponents have lost at least 2 life this turn.
2726-2906-7043.description:
Cast Aang by paying {W}{U}
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. When it enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Cast the Aang spell from exile by paying {0}.
Reflections of Littjara triggers, copying Aang.
Resolve the copy of the Aang spell. Put either Aang token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Aang token from step 5 enters, it triggers, airbending the Aang spell still on the stack.
Repeat from step 4.

1251-2440-6737-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
When Trusty Boomerang enters, Barret's triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token.
When the Rebel enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Rebel you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Rebel token.
Activate the Rebel by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature and returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1251-2440-6737-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Rebel.

1329-4659-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
1329-4659-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping the mana-producing creature.
Repeat.

1409-2499-3128.description:
Activate Skullport Merchant by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Skullport Merchant enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger twice.
Resolve both Deadeye Navigator triggers, repairing it and Skullport Merchant.
Resolve both Skullport Merchant triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

4050-5671-7084.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

4316-5344-6349.easyPrerequisites: You have not cast a spell from anywhere but your hand this turn.
4316-5344-6349.description:
Cast Charismatic Conqueror from the top of your library by paying {1}{W}.
Charismatic Conqueror's demonstrate ability triggers, causing you and an opponent to copy it.
Resolve the opponent's copy of Charismatic Conqueror, and then resolve your copy of Charismatic Conqueror.
When your Charismatic Conqueror token enters the battlefield,  the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to tap your Charismatic Conqueror token.
Resolve the original Charismatic Conqueror spell.
When the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the nontoken Charismatic Conqueror, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When the opponent's Vampire token enters the battlefield, both Charismatic Conquerors you control trigger, causing you to create at least one 1/1 Vampire creature token.
When your Vampire token enters the battlefield, the opponent's Charismatic Conqueror triggers, causing you to not tap the Vampire token, and causing the opponent to create a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
Repeat from step 7.

3490-3641-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3490-3641-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Distinguished Conjurer triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5485-6965.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-5485-6965.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

38-5220-5708-6900.description:
Activate Skirk Prospector by sacrificing it.
When Skirk Prospector dies, Mortuary and Vein Ripper trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Skirk Prospector from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Vein Ripper trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and target opponent to lose 2 life.
Cast Skirk Prospector from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

394-856-4321-5147.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
394-856-4321-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Desecrated Tomb trigger.
Resolve the Desecrated Tomb trigger, creating a creature token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

488-1492-2478-2895-4986.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one additional artifact on the battlefield.
One of either Mishra's Bauble or Welding Jar must be in your hand, with the other in your graveyard.
488-1492-2478-2895-4986.description:
Cast the artifact in your hand by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Uro from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Uro enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities and Loran trigger.
Resolve the first Uro trigger, sacrificing it.
Resolve the second Uro trigger, causing you to gain 3 life and draw a card, and allowing you to put a land card from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Loran trigger, returning the other {0} cost artifact from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the spell cast in step 1.
Activate the {0} cost artifact by sacrificing it.
Repeat.

2079-5696-5702.notablePrerequisites:
You have cast your commander from the command zone at least twice.
You have a way to cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control.
2079-5696-5702.description:
Cause a land to enter the battlefield under your control. Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Put the token Jyoti into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The token Jyoti's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Forest Dryad land creature token for each time you've cast your commander from the command zone this game.
When the Forest Dryads enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers that many times.
Holding priority, activate two Forest Dryads by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Repeat step 6 until there is only one Springheart Nantuko trigger remaining.
Resolve the final Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Jyoti.
Repeat from step 2.

147-3280.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Croaking Counterpart
147-3280.description:
Cast Croaking Counterpart by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Croaking Counterpart, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Croaking Counterpart, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage that is a 1/1 Frog.
Repeat from step 3.

997-2178-2527-3143.notablePrerequisites:
There is at least one counter on a permanent you control except Xavier Sal.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Xavier Sal.
You control at least one additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate that has no more than one +1/+1 counter on it.
997-2178-2527-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a +1/+1 counter from the additional nontoken Human, Fungus and/or Pirate if it has one, or any counter from another permanent you control otherwise.
Xavier Sal triggers, causing it and all other creatures you control that share a creature type with it to get +2/+0 and gain undying until end of turn.
Resolve the Xavier Sal ability, causing you to populate.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the additional Human, Fungus and/or Pirate.
When the creature dies, its undying ability and Xavier Sal trigger.
Resolve the creature's undying trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Xavier Sal trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

1270-1563-2457-2837.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating three 2/2 Cat creature tokens with haste.
Activate two Cats by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat.

1170-1328-4364.notablePrerequisites:
You have an instant card exiled by Spellbinder's imprint ability that has legal targets, if needed.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Spellbinder attached to any creature except Aurelia that does not have summoning sickness.
1170-1328-4364.description:
Declare Aurelia and the creature with Spellbinder attached as attackers.
Aurelia triggers, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Spellbinder attached.
Spellbinder triggers, causing you to copy a card exiled with it, and cast the copy without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Aurelia.
Resolve the spell cast in step 4.
Repeat each combat phase.

1416-2178-4395.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
1416-2178-4395.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1987-3542-4125.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-3542-4125.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Shipwreck Dowser and Palinchron.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Palinchron enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Palinchron trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.
If you control seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Palinchron.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

1052-2034-4668-4871.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Heliod, adding {C}{C}.
When Heliod dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Heliod from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Heliod enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Cast Minion's Return by paying {2}{B}, attaching it to Heliod.
Repeat.

1247-1528-1878.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has two or more cards in their hand.
1247-1528-1878.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pili-Pala by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Jeska's Will.
Resolve the copy of Jeska's Will, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.
1247-1528-1878.notes: If you control a commander, you can select both modes while casting Jeska's Will.

147-1532-5147.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-1532-5147.description:
Cast Faith's Reward by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Faith's Reward.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2174-3201-3525.notablePrerequisites:
Juniper Order Druid does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Juniper Order Druid.
Arixmethes has at least one slumber counter on it.
2174-3201-3525.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {U}{G}.
Activate Juniper Order Druid by tapping it, untapping Arixmethes.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Juniper Order Druid.
Repeat any number of times.

618-3580-5256.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 3.

976-1029-2428-3990-5042.notablePrerequisites:
Incubation Druid has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
Incubation Druid does not have summoning sickness.
976-1029-2428-3990-5042.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Greed by paying {B} and two life, causing you to draw two cards.
Horizon Chimera and Tolarian Kraken each trigger twice.
Resolve both Horizon Chimera triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Resolve the first Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Resolve the second Tolarian Kraken trigger, causing you to pay {1} to untap Incubation Druid.
Repeat.
